sources.title: Specification 700-713–16: Pressure Sensitive Adhesive Labels for Plastic and Metal Substrates for Use in Thermal Transfer Printers
sources.version_or_release: Specification Number 700-713–16; revision history records changes dated 2016-09-30; no commit identifier. Index lists as most recent PDF.
sources.locator: Scope and §§1.1–1.2 (PDF p. 1); §§2.4–2.7 (PDF pp. 1–3); package info §4.1 and revision history §5.5 (PDF p. 6).
sources.observed_operation: Opened and read official PDF scope, test procedures, printer conditions, and version history.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: LoC purchasing only; plastic/metal collection storage containers; thermal-transfer printer; excludes rare/high-value and photographic uses; no implied commercial endorsement. Specifies face stock selected for use, compatible vendor-recommended ribbon, and named printer. Initial dwell 7 days at 23°C/50% RH; accelerated aging 80°C/50% RH for 28 days then 24 hours at 23°C/50% RH. Bond, curl/lift/ooze, print fastness and abrasion are separate criteria.
sources.applicability: Useful test-design and traceability precedent, not a product recommendation, safety guarantee, case-specific acceptance threshold, or lifetime conversion. Accelerated conditions are not ordinary room storage and are not proposed for collection labels.
